title: Refining a derived_table adds parameters without dropping its SQL
rule: A refinement of derived_table merges the sub-parameters it sets into the base derived_table.

citations.quote: However, you can add refinements to the PDT's view, since refinements don't create a new copy of the object being refined.
in most cases a refinement will override the original settings of an object

rationale: The documentation recommends refinements for adding to persistent derived tables, and lists derived-table sub-parameters among the additive parameters, which only works if derived_table is merged parameter by parameter.
